answer_1.quote: In this work, we perform interactive evaluations to understand how LAMs are likely to be used and how they can be benchmarked.
answer_1.outputs: Text responses to voice input queries in a speech-in text-out setup

answer_2.quote: For automatic speech recognition, benchmarks such as Librispeech and Commonvoice are widely used, with metrics like word error rate (WER) and character error rate (CER).

answer_4.quote: we collect 7,500 interactions between 484 paid participants (all with prior commercial LLM chat experience) and 6 speech-in text-out systems
answer_4.guideline: users provide a simple pairwise preference ranking—choosing the better response or indicating no preference between the two
